LESSON: LINEAR MOTION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: GENERAL SCIENCE
Strand: Natural Physical Science
Topic 3.2: Linear motion
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Linear motion, part of Natural Physical Science in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 GENERAL SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How is free fall motion important in real life? 2. How can the dangers of free fall in our day to day life be mitigated?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Linear motion together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: as the learner works with peers to discuss and present in plenary the application of

linear motion in real life.

● Learning to learn: as the learner carries out assignments on examples of bodies under free fall motion and presents the

findings in a group discussion.

Values:
● Peace: the learner displays tolerance and calmness when discussing the application of linear motion in real life.

55

● Unity: the learner displays cooperation and collaboration with others while investigating the effect of gravity on

objects.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Road safety: increased awareness on how to minimise fatal injuries resulting from road crashes on sloping roads using

the concept of free fall of objects.

• Life Skills Education; Self-awareness: the learner observes safety measures when dropping objects to investigate the

effect of gravity on objects.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Print textbooks in appropriate font and colour.

• Braille textbooks.

• Digital devices with assistive technology such as screen readers and screen magnifiers.

• Real objects like masses, pendulum ball e.t.c

Key skills:

● Investigating the effect of gravity on a free fall motion.

• Calculating variables of motion using equations of linear motion with constant acceleration
